newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Golden Ring to list A shares in Shenzhen.
newsitem.headline: Golden Ring to list A shares in Shenzhen.

text.p: China's chemical fibre producer Hubei Golden Ring Co Ltd said it was due to list 11.328 million A shares and 1.672 million staff shares on the Shenzhen stock exchange on October 16.

The A shares were issued at 7.80 yuan per share in Shenzhen last month, while the staff shares were offered at a fairly low price several years ago, Golden Ring said in a notice carried in the official Securities Times on Monday.
It did not give the issue price of the staff shares.
The securities code for the stock has been set as "0615" and Hubei Securities has been named Golden Ring's listing promoter.
Golden Ring currently has total share capital of 51.988 million shares, comprising 32.30 million legal person shares, 11.328 million A shares and 8.36 million employee shares.

Based in Xiangyang county in China's central Hubei province, Golden Ring said it had forecast net earnings of 27.98 million yuan for this year, compared with 22.55 million yuan in 1995 and 21.47 million yuan a year earlier.
Golden Ring said in its prospectus that it plans to use the proceeds from the offer to expand its output of chemical fibre and revamp production facilities.
